description: Move to the next workspace when the active workspace is the last one on the focused monitor but creating empty workspaces ahead is disabled. Because no further workspace exists on the monitor and the caller has opted out of opening a brand-new empty workspace in that direction, the operation makes no change and returns the active workspace id unchanged. This holds whether the monitor has several workspaces or only the single active one, and regardless of whether other monitors happen to occupy higher ids. The direction selector requests the next workspace.
